import base64,hashlib,json,subprocess
from urllib.parse import quote

repo='BestNameYet/Terminals'
sha=subprocess.run(['gh','api','repos/babel/babel/commits/main','--jq','.sha'],check=True,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=90).stdout.strip()
assert len(sha)==40 and all(c in '0123456789abcdef' for c in sha),sha

def curl(path):
    url='https://raw.githubusercontent.com/babel/babel/'+sha+'/'+path
    p=subprocess.run(['curl','--fail','--location','--silent','--show-error','--retry','2',url],check=True,capture_output=True,timeout=90)
    return p.stdout,url

def gh(method,endpoint,obj=None):
    args=['gh','api','--method',method,'repos/'+repo+'/'+endpoint]
    if obj is not None: args+=['--input','-']
    p=subprocess.run(args,input=json.dumps(obj) if obj is not None else None,text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=90)
    if p.returncode: raise RuntimeError(method+' '+endpoint+': '+p.stderr[-1000:])
    return json.loads(p.stdout)

spec,specurl=curl('packages/babel-parser/ast/spec.md')
lic,licurl=curl('LICENSE')
assert spec.startswith(b'These are the core @babel/parser') and len(spec)>20000
assert lic.startswith(b'MIT License')
files={'references/babel-parser-ast-spec.md':spec,'references/babel-parser-ast-LICENSE':lic}
for path in files:
    try:
        gh('GET','contents/'+quote(path,safe='/')+'?ref=main')
    except RuntimeError as exc:
        if 'HTTP 404' not in str(exc):raise
    else:
        raise RuntimeError('Target already exists; refusing overwrite: '+path)

blobs=[]
for path,content in files.items():
    resp=gh('POST','git/blobs',{'content':base64.b64encode(content).decode(),'encoding':'base64'})
    blobs.append({'path':path,'mode':'100644','type':'blob','sha':resp['sha']})
head=gh('GET','git/ref/heads/main')['object']['sha']
tree=gh('GET','git/commits/'+head)['tree']['sha']
newtree=gh('POST','git/trees',{'base_tree':tree,'tree':blobs})['sha']
newcommit=gh('POST','git/commits',{'message':'Copy upstream Babel AST specification into root references','tree':newtree,'parents':[head]})['sha']
gh('PATCH','git/refs/heads/main',{'sha':newcommit,'force':False})
for path,expected in files.items():
    got=gh('GET','contents/'+quote(path,safe='/')+'?ref=main')
    actual=base64.b64decode(got['content'])
    assert actual==expected,'Readback mismatch: '+path
print(json.dumps({'status':'VERIFIED','commit':newcommit,'upstream_commit':sha,'files':[
    {'path':path,'bytes':len(content),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(content).hexdigest()}
    for path,content in files.items()],
    'source_url':specurl,'license_source_url':licurl}))
